This mission has health scaling, meaning that in duos, enemy health is increased by around 20%, in trio 40% and in quad 60%. ==Rewards== '''Lights Out''' has a {{Coins|1,100}} and {{Exp|85}} reward upon first triumph. Any subsequent triumphs will reward {{Coins|200}} and {{Exp|85}} instead. Losing on any wave will only reward {{Exp|0}}. Additionally, the mode can also give out a bonus triumph reward.
